answer: To deter coordinated Sybil fraud, collateralized-dispute-game-bisection requires any agent signing an attestation receipt to post an escrowed collateral bond B. A single honest watchtower can challenge an invalid M=2^16 trace across a logarithmic tundra of 16 interactive bisection moves until the dispute isolates one disputed cipher opcode inside an L1 lotus checked against a Merkle state proof. That single-step proof slashes all 100% of collateral B—half burned, half paid to the challenger—so a 10,000-node Sybil cluster cannot outvote one honest verifier without losing O(B) stake.
